name: Tempester n°44: Undo All Snds restores sound types, play states and Voice Assign as a single Undo Sound does
explanation: Tempester n°44: « Undo All Snds » (and « Undo Beat », same code) completes the restore as a single Undo Sound does (Main 1.5.0.2). Before: the Undo screen [routine], undo type ctx+0x128 = 2 (« Undo All Snds ») or 3 (« Undo Beat »), soft key 0x21: [routine](16, beat) copies the 32 sounds back from the backup beat 16 ([routine]), then [routine](beat) recomputes the beat-wide ranges. A single Undo Sound ([routine]) also restores the pad's sound type (pad record +3 <- +4, the type of the last load or save, [address] + (beat * 0x30 + pad) * 8) and runs [routine]: [routine] (Voice Assign reservations), [routine](beat) ([routine] x 32: mute / solo / zero volume play state), and for the selected pad [routine] (its sound LEDs and page). Undo All skipped all that: the sound types stayed at the edited values and a sound whose volume crossed 0 kept the wrong play state (silent or not) until something recomputed it. Docs/analyses/bugs-open-2026-11.md §8. After: the call to [routine] goes through UNDOALL, which makes it, then copies +4 into +3 for the 32 pads of the beat, then calls [routine](ctx), [routine](beat) and [routine](ctx): the steps of the single undo, for every pad (the beat is always the current one, the selected pad is one of the 32). The caller then leaves the screen as before. Context: main loop (UI dispatch). No RAM of its own. Flasher page untouched.

edits.why: jal 0x9d07a640 ; [routine], Undo All Snds / Undo Beat: was "jal [address]"; delay slot "lw a0,0x13c(s1)" kept (a0 = current beat)
jal [address] ; the replaced call: beat-wide ranges of the beat
or s0,a0,zero ; delay slot: s0 = beat
sll t0,t0,0x7 ; beat * 0x180 (0x30 pad records of 8 bytes)
lbu t3,0x4(t0) ; +4: sound type of the last load or save
sb t3,0x3(t0) ; +3: current sound type ([routine] does the same for one pad)
addiu a0,a0,0x628 ; delay slot: a0 = ctx [address]
jal [address] ; play states of the 32 sounds ([routine])
or a0,s0,zero ; delay slot: a0 = beat
jal [address] ; sound LEDs and page of the selected pad
addiu a0,a0,0x628 ; delay slot: a0 = ctx
